_comment: MCP server registry for Claude Code. Source of truth for ~/.claude/mcp.json. Phase 4 will populate the foundational tier (filesystem, git, memory, fetch, smart-connections); Phase 6 the OSINT tier (shodan, osint-37, security-hub). Secrets reference env vars by name only — never inline values.

claw-sec._comment: Scope-gated security toolchain (ADR-002 OSINT tier). Every tools/call goes through registry.invoke(), which holds the gate, the rate limiter, the kill switch and the hash-chained audit — the adapter itself has no authorization logic. active-invasive tools are absent from tools/list unless the engagement opts in with --invasive. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-23-security-harness-design.md
